title: The QWAdata class
text: QWAdata object named list two components: $cells — cell-level measurements, one row per cell. $rings — ring-level measurements quality flags, one row per annual ring per image. least one component must present; may NULL. object carry ROXAS settings hierarchical metadata — stay accompanying QWAimages QWAmetadata object, linked QWAdata via image_label key.

title: The QWAdata class
text: normal use, QWAdata built incrementally three steps: collect_raw_data() reads cells rings tables ROXAS output files referenced QWAimages object, cleans invalid values (negatives, error codes → NA), returns minimal QWAdata raw measurements . complete_QWAdata() runs full preprocessing pipeline (see Completing QWAdata object ) check_QWAdata() checks result. can also construct QWAdata object directly existing data frames, example importing another source: constructor enforces minimal column requirements (image_label, year, xpix, ypix cells; image_label, year rings), coerces column types, fills year gaps rings sequence, checks dating problems (duplicate years, future years). warns cwttan -NA image, indicates missing cell wall thickness estimates — expected conifers, acceptable angiosperms.
code: # Step 1: read raw ROXAS output into a QWAdata object QWA_data <- collect_raw_data(rxs_images)  # Step 2: add derived measures and ring quality flags QWA_data <- complete_QWAdata(QWA_data, meta = rxs_images)  # Step 3: check check_QWAdata(QWA_data) QWA_data <- QWAdata(cells = df_cells, rings = df_rings)

title: The QWAdata class

code: QWA_data          # same as print(QWA_data): compact overview summary(QWA_data) # identical output

title: The QWAdata class
text: One row per cell. Columns fall three groups: Identifiers: image_label (links QWAimages), year, pixel coordinates xpix / ypix. Raw measurements: cell dimensions wall thickness directly ROXAS — lumen dimensions (drad, dtan), radial distribution (rraddistr), lumen area (la), cell wall areas (cwa), cell wall thicknesses (cwtrad, cwttan, cwtall, rtsr). Derived measures (colType derived, added complete_QWAdata()): tca, rwd2, dcwt, cwtall_adj, cdrad, cdtan, cdratio, sector100. Estimate (added complete_QWAdata()): ew_lw (earlywood / latewood classification based Mork’s index; depends method choices, always kept).

title: The QWAdata class
text: One row per ring per image. Columns fall four groups: Identifiers: woodpiece_label, slide_label, image_label, year. Measurements: cell count (cno, recounted $cells), mean ring width (mrw), ring area (ra) ROXAS ring measures. Estimates (added complete_QWAdata()): earlywood latewood widths (eww, lww, based Mork’s index). Quality flags (added complete_QWAdata()): logical columns described next section. Quality-control inputs (colType qc_input): ring flags, affected_tissue comment, set flags app (see vignette("flags-app")). never added complete_QWAdata().

title: The QWAdata class
text: complete_QWAdata() runs three operations sequence returns new QWAdata object: Year sequence completion — extends $rings cover every year cells data (filling gaps cno = 0 FALSE flag columns), aborts dating problems, including ring years outmost_year meta (+1 incomplete outermost ring). Derived measures estimates — computes derived estimate columns listed yet present. Already-present columns skipped, re-running safe. Ring quality flags — adds five logical columns $rings: Missing rings excluded default, zero width valid measurement. use different rule, set exclude_issues afterwards, e.g. QWA_data$rings$exclude_issues <- QWA_data$rings$incomplete_ring | QWA_data$rings$missing_ring. NA exclude_dupl exclude_issues counts FALSE. extract_ring_measures() returns identifier measurement columns without excluded rings, input analyses. need finer control, e.g. add derived measures without adding flags, call complete_measures() complete_flags() separately. add missing columns; recompute column, remove first.
code: QWA_data <- complete_QWAdata(QWA_data, meta = rxs_images)

title: The QWAdata class
text: check_QWAdata() returns TRUE invisibly issue found, FALSE otherwise. strict = TRUE, aborts first issue instead warning. Errors: invalid object, .e. missing, mistyped NA identifiers, duplicate (image, year) $rings. Warnings: values violating schema (types, ranges, allowed values); duplicate cell keys (image, year, xpix, ypix); gaps future years; images $cells $rings, years cells without rings row, cno matching number cells (re-run complete_QWAdata()). Information: missing optional columns, extra columns, images cwttan entirely NA. check data images (e.g. ring years outmost_year), use check_consistency(meta = rxs_images, data = QWA_data).
code: check_QWAdata(QWA_data)

title: The QWAdata class
text: QWAdata written two separate CSV files — one cells, one rings. Provide either directory (files named automatically) explicit paths: Compression defaults TRUE write_QWAdata() (unlike write_QWAimages(), defaults FALSE). read_QWAdata() accepts .csv .csv.gz. Empty values written empty fields. drop_empty = TRUE (default), optional qc_input columns empty rows (NA, NA/FALSE flags) written; read_QWAdata() re-create . keep_derived = FALSE, derived columns written; recompute complete_QWAdata(). Estimates (ew_lw, eww, lww) always written.
code: # Using a directory — files named {dataset_name}_QWAcells.csv.gz and # {dataset_name}_QWArings.csv.gz write_QWAdata(QWA_data, dir = "output/", dataset_name = "my_dataset")  # Or with explicit paths: write_QWAdata(QWA_data,               file_cells = "output/my_dataset_QWAcells.csv.gz",               file_rings = "output/my_dataset_QWArings.csv.gz")  # Read back: QWA_data <- read_QWAdata(dir = "output/", dataset_name = "my_dataset")  # Read only rings (avoids loading a large cells file): QWA_data_rings <- read_QWAdata(file_rings = "output/my_dataset_QWArings.csv.gz")

title: The QWAimages class
text: QWAimages object tibble subclass — one row per analysed image — collects everything rest package needs know raw ROXAS data: files live, images organised hierarchically, image EXIF properties, ROXAS (AI) settings used analysis. required input collect_raw_data() $images component inside QWAmetadata object. object carries single attribute, roxas_version ("roxas" "roxas_ai"), records software produced data determines expected column set.

title: The QWAimages class
text: normal use, call QWAimages() directly. Instead, use build_QWAimages(), combines output extract_data_structure() (hierarchical labels) collect_settings_data() (per-image ROXAS settings EXIF metadata). See main rxs2tria vignette step--step walkthrough. build_QWAimages() checks label hierarchy (aborting invalid), aligns columns types JSON schema software version (adding missing required columns NA, dropping unrecognised columns, warning coercions) validates result schema (warnings ). already data frame right columns — example reading non-standard source — can pass directly QWAimages(). infers validates roxas_version $software column alignment, warns invalid hierarchy:
code: files        <- get_roxas_files("path/to/ROXAS_data", roxas_version = "roxas") df_structure <- extract_data_structure(files, pattern = "...") df_settings  <- collect_settings_data(df_structure)  rxs_images <- build_QWAimages(df_structure, df_settings) rxs_images <- QWAimages(my_df, roxas_version = "roxas")

Image metadata — properties extracted image EXIF data ROXAS AI metadata file: ROXAS settings — parameters ROXAS settings ROXAS AI metadata file (e.g. magnification, threshold values). exact columns differ roxas_version values. Dating — outmost_year calendar year outermost complete ring image, used validate ring years exceed .
